prompt:
Image 1 is the exact character: a chibi young forest knight with messy brown hair, big golden antlers with green leaves, green eyes, ornate white-gold and emerald armour wrapped in pale roots and covered in green leaves, a long leafy cape and tabard, a huge emerald crystal war hammer bound with pale roots in his right hand and a large emerald shield with a golden tree emblem framed by pale roots and leaves on his left arm. Keep his identity, face, costume, colours, proportions, line style and the exact hammer and shield designs from Image 1, at the same size and camera distance as Image 1, three-quarter view facing screen-right like Image 1.

Draw ONE single full-body sprite of him about to stomp: behind his big emerald shield whose lower rim still rests on the ground in front of him, he stands on his left leg and lifts his right knee high toward his chest, the boot sole facing down, body leaning slightly back for power, the crystal hammer held low at his right side, fierce focused face, cape and leaves lifting.

Background: 100% solid flat magenta #FF00FF, no gradient, no floor, no shadow. Centered, the whole character, hammer and shield fully inside the image with a wide magenta margin on all four sides. Clean anime game sprite, crisp lines, same rendering as Image 1. No glow, aura, dust, cracks, particles, speed lines, text or labels.

problems.detail: The raised right knee and boot are hard to read. The boot appears to float beside the tabard rather than clearly attaching to a lifted thigh, and the hammer-holding arm is partly hidden behind the cape, so limb structure is ambiguous.

precheck.summary: The background is flat magenta, the character design, antlers, hair, hammer and shield match the reference, and nothing is cropped. The only concern is that the raised leg and hammer arm are not clearly legible, so a human should check limb anatomy.
